about: Posts shown on adhx.com. Each is a real save from the owner’s own ADHX server, taken from its public, anonymous Right now data (GET /api/moments and /api/moments/{slug}) and the kept files those point to. Clips are short, muted excerpts re-encoded for the web. Every post is credited on the page with its network's mark and its author's handle.
